metadata.source_notes: MagicTile supplies the non-Euclidean twisty-puzzle and Poincare-disc interaction thesis; MagicCube4D supplies the projected permutation-puzzle context; cubing.js/Twizzle supplies the explicit state-transform, scramble, and exact solved-check pattern. The finite heptagonal tiling, sticker cycles, presentation, generator, input surfaces, grader, verifier, and solver are original.
metadata.notes: The L3 baseline has twelve logical faces, four strongly distorted rim faces, a four-twist recorded scramble, and a six-twist limit. Mobius view changes never mutate sticker state; every twist is independently replayed and must occur with its face inside the central turning aperture through the selected input surface.
